standard.title: Indian Standard — Proforma for Purchase Specification for Plate Bending Machines
standard.sector: Production Engineering / Metal Forming Machines and Tools

sectional_committee.name: Metal Forming Machines and Tools Sectional Committee

standard.description: This standard lays down the proforma for the preparation of purchase specifications for plate bending machines. It also gives essential information about plate bending machines and their accessories which will enable the user to assess their usefulness and applicability.
standard.scope: This standard lays down the proforma for the preparation of purchase specifications for plate bending machines. It also gives essential information about plate bending machines and their accessories which will enable the user to assess their usefulness and applicability.

certification.description: Since this document is a purchase proforma designed to collect standard data from machine tool manufacturers, a standard product stamp is not applicable on the form itself. However, sub-components of the machine (such as electrical motors, cables, and structural steels) must conform to their respective standard marking schemes governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards.
requirements: The proforma is structurally formatted to enable buyers to easily collect, organize, and compile uniform engineering data from different manufacturers and suppliers for side-by-side comparison.

Mandates explicit manufacturer data on geometrical boundaries: top roll diameter, bottom roll diameter, bottom roll centre distance, maximum adjusting range of the top/bottom rolls, and counterbalance method of the top roll (Manual, Mechanical, or Hydraulic).
Requires declaration of rolling limits: minimum internal diameter of the rolled cylinder, the number of sequential passes required to form a complete cylinder, and standard flat end dimensions.
Requires suppliers to itemize the supplied standard accessories in detail, as well as define special tooling and structural accessories offered.
When submitting commercial bids and quotations, the manufacturer/supplier is structurally required to furnish full technical catalogs and the official capacity chart of the machine.
Requires dimensions of floor space occupied (length and breadth in millimetres) along with the complete net shipping weight of the machine including electrical gear and standard accessories.
